text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gwooooh, I can't reach! Dammit all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka slammed her fists against the 
ground, thud! thud! She couldn't defeat 
Daiwa Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a shame, Vodka. Your face is 
beet red, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, just when did you get this 
strong... !?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, the me after Make a Debut isn't the 
me you used to know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've studied race developments and course 
positioning, and trained so I can run 
completely at will.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series isn't child's play. I'm 
gonna get stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ghk...! Next time! Just you watch next 
time! Today was just a warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna crush you in the real deal, the 
Oka Sho, so you'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Then we'll settle it at the Oka Sho. 
Not that the pecking order is going to 
change anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll change it! I'll definitely change it! 
I'm turning this around, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka barks out a sharp retort and walks 
away in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... regarding Vodka's running form, has 
it changed a little?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's full of openings as usual, but 
there's this fierce intensity to her 
now...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What kind of training have you been doing?
choice_data_list:
It's probably the result of real-race 
experience.

It's probably the result of real-race 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka had fearlessly challenged GⅠ races 
from an early stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the fruits of pushing your limits 
to take on challenges are showing in your 
races as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Actual races... Right...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When she suddenly started talking about 
G1s last year, I thought she was just 
being an idiot again, but it turns out she 
had her reasons after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, even so, it looks like there's still 
quite a gap between her and me♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I'll see just what you're 
made of. At our next real race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next big stage’— It sounds like a 
natural promise, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta admit, I underestimated 'em. Guess 
that one ain't just some goody-two-shoes 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Showing your true colors now, huh? Things 
just got interesting.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer, about the next race, it's 
obviously gonna be the 'Oka Sho', right?"
choice_data_list: It's not that simple, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What do you mean?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Triple Crown route" and the 
"Triple Tiara route." I will now explain 
the two racing formats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If one enters the Oka Sho on the Tiara 
route, the standard path is to follow it 
up with the Yushun Himba and the Shuka 
Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we aim for the Triple Tiara, we must 
give up on the Triple Crown route's Japan 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So if I go to the Oka Sho, does that mean 
I won't be able to run in the Derby?!
choice_data_list:
It's not impossible, but nobody normally 
does it.

It's not impossible, but nobody normally 
does that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You only get one chance in a lifetime to 
challenge the Triple Crown or the Triple 
Tiara. Throwing away that opportunity with 
your race choices is normally unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, what the heck am I supposed to do 
then?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just when he was finally getting 
challenging... To take him on in the 
Classics, do I really have to give up on 
the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. How about something like this!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about running in all six races of both 
the Triple Crown and the Tiara, and 
winning every single one?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really~!? What are we supposed to do 
with this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It is a momentous question. Take the 
Tiara route to face her rivals, or aim for 
the Classic Triple Crown to run in the 
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's probably no right answer. But 
Vodka and I have to find our own solution 
together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, something just came to mind. 
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bring myself to drop either 
of 'em. Before, I'd have cut that guy 
loose without a second thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet's running today felt different 
somehow. I could sense real spirit that 
wasn't just talk, and a terrifying future 
in her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't shake this burning desire to 
take her on in a real GⅠ. So—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about going from the Oka Sho straight 
to the Japanese Derby? I think that's our 
only real option.
choice_data_list:
Are you giving up on the Triple Crown and 
the Triple Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I didn't say I was giving up! It's 
just...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is the only thing I can think of! If 
I want to chase after everything I refuse 
to give up—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice was filled with resolve. It 
might be premature to make a decision at 
this stage, but...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Oka Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-You understand, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
However, let's leave the rest for after 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So she means we'll talk after the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's do that. Yeah... it 
ain't something to take lightly anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, but I'm not staying a loser 
forever. First up, I'm taking her on in 
the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've decided not to choose my path just 
yet. Everything depends on the outcome of 
the Oka Sho, and my resolve thereafter.
